title: Agent Bazaar: register an on-chain agent identity
summary: Initialise the protocol with a platform fee, register an agent, and see why fee_bps=10001 is rejected.
what: Agent Bazaar is an Anchor 0.31 program for an on-chain agent registry (identity + reputation). This lesson covers initialize and register_agent. The hosted IDL is a hand-derived subset confirmed on-chain.
app_note: The page at /dapps/agent-bazaar/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console, with this devnet program id filled in.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/agent-bazaar/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. initialize and register_agent campus-scout are already done.

diagram: authority --initialize--> protocol ["protocol"] ; owner --register_agent--> identity ["agent", count] + reputation ["reputation", count]
instructions: update/deactivate/feedback ixs exist in the program but are not in this IDL
innovation: A public on-chain identity and reputation registry for AI agents.
not_covered: update_agent, deactivate/reactivate/close, update_fee and submit_feedback were not exercised.
build: Anchor 0.31.1 program at 4JLHcJkEhBWxb8g9m5uZVjavS7vjhJ9yAVHUeShvM2Tx on devnet. IDL hand-derived subset, tx-confirmed.
student_outcome: Inspect protocol config and an agent identity, then explain why fee_bps=10001 is rejected.

learning_loop.objective: Read protocol fee + agent identity — then predict InvalidFee.
learning_loop.predict_question: initialize is called with fee_bps=10001. What should happen?

predict_options.label: Fee is clamped to 10000 and initialize succeeds

learning_loop.predict_why: Agent Bazaar rejects out-of-range platform fees during initialize. An illegal fee_bps does not produce a valid protocol config.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/agent-bazaar/ on Devnet. Fetch the lab agent identity and protocol config. Prefer recorded initialize/register_agent proofs; explain InvalidFee from the exercise.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why is an out-of-range fee_bps a program error rather than a UI-only warning?
learning_loop.transfer: Name the rejected fee condition and one agent-identity field you would verify on-chain.

assessment.purpose: Independent criteria for Agent Bazaar elective: fee bounds + identity.

criteria.title: Reads protocol config / agent
criteria.question: Can the student record fee and agent identity from evidence?
criteria.support: Finds lab agent after a prompt.
criteria.independent: Records config fee_bps and agent fields.
criteria.misconception: Display name is the on-chain identity account.

criteria.title: Explains InvalidFee
criteria.question: Can the student predict fee_bps=10001 rejection?
criteria.misconception: Illegal fee still initialised the protocol.

criteria.title: Honest scope
criteria.question: Does the student limit claims to init/register/InvalidFee?
criteria.misconception: Registered agent means marketplace trades completed.
